description: This bar chart illustrates the variance explained by different model sizes and data mixtures. The horizontal axis displays the categories, representing combinations of model size (70B or 66B llama) and data mixture (70B llama, 66 llama, 1-MVS). The axis labels are arranged alphabetically by data mixture within each model size. The vertical axis represents the variance explained, labeled as a numeric scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each category is represented by a stacked bar composed of two colored segments: a teal segment and a blue segment. For the 70B llama models, the variance explained ranges from approximately 0.68 for the 70B llama data mixture to 0.72 for the 1-MVS data mixture. For the 66B llama models, the variance explained ranges from approximately 0.54 for the 66 llama data mixture to 0.62 for the 1-MVS data mixture. The bars are not explicitly sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
